verdict.rationale: MX documents self-serve developer API keys via the Client Dashboard (free, easy to obtain) plus a sandbox with test institutions and an importable OpenAPI spec for Postman/API exploration, and offers Web/React Native SDKs to embed Connect. However there's no explicit 'quickstart' tutorial evidenced, client libraries are limited to JS/React Native (no broader multi-language SDK coverage), and the direct openapi.json endpoint 404s (spec only via GitHub repo). Missing for 10: explicit fast quickstart guide, multi-language client libraries beyond web/RN, and a working hosted OpenAPI endpoint.
